name: GitHub
description_en:
GitHub hosts Git repositories and the collaboration around them: changes, issues, pull-request review, project planning and automation. Developers can keep code history, discussion and checks beside the same change, while using tools such as GitHub Actions to run configured build/test/deployment work.

The GitHub platform is broader than Git itself and includes separately scoped services such as Copilot, Codespaces and security products. Repository hosting is not automatically a working production application, and public visibility is not automatically an open-source license. This profile focuses on the code-to-checked-change workflow and its access/cost conditions.
description_zh:
GitHub 托管 Git 仓库及周边协作：改动、issue、pull request 审阅、项目规划和自动化。开发者可将代码历史、讨论及检查放在同一改动旁，使用 GitHub Actions 执行配置的构建／测试／部署。

平台范围比 Git 本身广，另含 Copilot、Codespaces、安全等服务。托管代码不代表生产应用已可用，公开可见也不自动取得开源许可。本文聚焦代码至受检查改动的流程及访问／费用条件。

core_features.explanation_zh: 分配协作权限，按需执行合并／推送条件。

sections.title_en: Make a change reviewable and reproducible
sections.en: A proposed evaluation could modify one small application behavior, commit the files and compare the diff/history. The documented GitHub flow uses a branch and pull request so collaborators can discuss the change and configured checks can run before merging. That is one supported collaboration pattern, not a requirement for every repository. Inspect what changed, how it was tested and which commit is being reviewed. No new repository, issue or pull request was created for this research.
sections.zh: 建议以一个小应用行为改动试验，提交文件并比较差异／历史。GitHub flow 文档采用分支及 pull request，让协作者讨论，并在合并前运行所配置检查。这是支持的协作模式之一，不是全部仓库必需流程。需核对改动、测试方式及审阅提交。本研究未创建新仓库、issue 或 pull request。

sections.title_en: Workflow files specify what actually runs
sections.title_zh: 实际执行内容由 workflow 文件决定
sections.en: Actions workflows are YAML files under .github/workflows. Events start jobs; job dependencies determine sequencing, and steps run code or reusable actions on a runner. A repository without a relevant configured workflow does not automatically test or deploy every commit. In a disposable evaluation, deliberately fail one assertion and inspect the job/step log, then verify a corrected commit. A green build is evidence only of the checks that ran, not that the public application or every user journey works.
sections.zh: Actions workflow 为 .github/workflows 下 YAML。事件启动 job，依赖决定顺序，step 在 runner 执行脚本或可复用 action。未配置相关 workflow 的仓库不会自动测试或部署每个提交。可在可丢弃试验中有意使断言失败、检查 job／step 日志，再验证修正提交。绿色构建只能证明实际运行检查，不能证明公开应用及所有流程正常。

sections.title_en: A collaboration role and a branch rule solve different problems
sections.title_zh: 协作角色与分支规则解决不同问题
sections.en: Organization repositories offer Read, Triage, Write, Maintain and Admin roles. Branch rules can separately require checks, restrict pushes or protect history. Availability differs for public/private repositories and plans. Classic protection excludes admins by default unless configured otherwise; do not infer that a protected label constrains every actor. Deploy keys have another access path and can remain usable after a person leaves the organization. Review the actual account, app/key and repository settings before relying on a particular access boundary.
sections.zh: 组织仓库有 Read、Triage、Write、Maintain、Admin 角色。分支规则另可要求检查、限制推送或保护历史，公开／私有及套餐可用性不同。经典保护默认不限制管理员，除非另配置，不能从受保护标签推断约束全部参与者。部署 key 又是另一访问路径，人员离开组织后仍可能使用。依赖具体边界前需核查账号、应用／key 及实际仓库设置。

sections.title_en: Failed jobs and retained artifacts can still cost money
sections.title_zh: 失败 job 及保留产物仍可能计费
sections.en: Actions billing distinguishes standard hosted runners for public repositories from private-repository allowances and paid overages. Costs belong to the repository owner, including runs initiated by writers. A failed five-minute run plus a successful ten-minute retry consumes fifteen minutes. Artifact storage accrues hourly; deleting an artifact stops future storage accrual but does not erase earlier accrued usage. Artifact/Packages storage share an allowance, while cache has a separate per-repository allowance. Budget both compute attempts and retained data rather than assuming only successful jobs count.
sections.zh: Actions 区分公开仓库标准托管 runner、私有仓库额度及超额。费用归仓库所有者，包括写权限用户触发的运行。失败五分钟后成功重跑十分钟，会消耗十五分钟。产物存储按小时累计，删除仅停止后续存储计费，不清除此前累计；产物与 Packages 共享额度，cache 则另按仓库分配。预算应包括失败尝试及保留数据，不能只算成功 job。

sections.title_en: Separate seat subscriptions from metered products
sections.title_zh: 区分席位订阅与计量产品
sections.en: The current page lists Free at $0 with unlimited public/private repositories, Team at $4/user/month and Enterprise starting $21/user/month. Team/Enterprise figures carry a first-12-month label, so renewal must be confirmed. Actions, Codespaces, Copilot and security capabilities have their own allowances, usage or add-ons; not every page feature is included in a seat price. For example, current Free organizations receive 2,000 standard-runner minutes and 500 MB artifact allowance. Confirm account type, repository visibility, seats and usage rather than quoting a single all-in platform price.
sections.zh: 当前页面列 Free $0、公开／私有仓库不限，Team 每用户每月 $4，Enterprise $21 起；后两者带前十二月标记，续费需确认。Actions、Codespaces、Copilot、安全能力另有额度、计量或附加项，不能把页面全部功能算入席位价。例如当前免费组织含两千标准 runner 分钟及五百 MB 产物额度。应确认账号类型、可见性、席位及用量，不能给单一完整平台价。

sections.title_en: Public source and open-source rights are separate
sections.title_zh: 公开源码与开源权利需区分
sections.en: The licensing guide says a public repository needs an appropriate license to grant open-source reuse rights; without one, ordinary copyright restrictions still apply. GitHub terms separately permit viewing/forking on the service, and existing forks or local copies survive a later switch to private. Review a project’s own license rather than applying Git’s license or GitHub’s public-hosting status to it. This also does not establish that the entire GitHub hosted platform is open source. Full platform terms and individual project licenses were not audited here.
sections.zh: 许可指南说明公开仓库仍需适当许可才授予开源复用权，没有许可仍适用通常版权限制。GitHub 条款另允许在服务内查看／fork，之后改私有也不会移除既有 fork 或本地副本。应检查项目自身许可，不能套 Git 许可或 GitHub 公开托管状态；同样不能由此证明完整托管平台开源。本次未审计整个平台条款及各项目许可。
